# Let's parse the schedule to compute available work time
import re

schedule_content = """# Morning
Exercise        => 180 minutes
Work hours      => 120 minutes
# Afternoon
Lunch break     => 120 minutes
Work hours      => 1 hours
# Evening
Dinner & relax  => 1 hours
Work hours      => 5 hours"""

# Find all lines with "Work hours" and extract duration
work_minutes = 0
for line in schedule_content.split('\n'):
    if 'Work hours' in line:
        # Extract number and unit
        match = re.search(r'Work hours\s*=>\s*([\d.]+)\s*(minutes|hours)', line)
        if match:
            value = float(match.group(1))
            unit = match.group(2)
            if unit == 'hours':
                work_minutes += value * 60
            else:
                work_minutes += value

print(f"Total work minutes: {work_minutes}")
